objective: Aplicar la correccion R28 al detalle historico SoftRestaurant de CIENFUEGOS para 2026-10-18. Reconstruir el detalle cerrado con la ventana canonica transversal [09:00, siguiente 09:00), conciliar contra Runtime/encabezado y dejar el detalle visible completo. No modificar ManagementPro, sync_comercial_abiertas_v2, KPI/Runtime ni Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_oct18_post_backfill_parity
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT numero_ticket,SUM(ISNULL(importe_neto,0)) AS venta_ticket,MAX(ISNULL(pax,0)) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-18' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 AND numero_ticket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY numero_ticket), ds AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS detalle_ventas,COUNT(*) AS detalle_tickets,SUM(pax_ticket) AS detalle_pax FROM d), r AS (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,tickets_total AS runtime_tickets,pax_total AS runtime_pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-18') SELECT ds.detalle_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets,ds.detalle_pax,r.runtime_ventas,r.runtime_tickets,r.runtime_pax,CAST(ds.detalle_ventas-r.runtime_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets-r.runtime_tickets AS delta_tickets,ds.detalle_pax-r.runtime_pax AS delta_pax FROM ds CROSS JOIN r
